A vintage-style poster, inspired by 1950s beauty ads, printed in a limited red-toned palette on a cream background, showcases a luminous pink donut and an eggplant with a syringe. The poster features a large, bold headline at the top that reads, "SWEETER THAN YOUR EX, AND TWICE AS LOYAL," arched across in all caps in a mid-century serif font. Beneath the headline, a tagline in a stylized font states, "Indulge Yourself."

The stylized, engraved illustration in the center of the poster features a luminous pink donut with subtle holographic shimmer and tiny, bright, translucent sprinkles, appearing almost weightless with a soft golden base peaking through the translucent icing. Beside it, an eggplant with a syringe inserted into it. Around the headline, a few mid-century sparkle and starburst icons add flair. At the bottom of the poster, the funny footer line "Still buffering, mentally ooo" is present. All fonts feel like a throwback print ad, and the color palette is limited to retro vintage tones.
